cbstv.label: CBS TV
cbstv.plot: Cybernetic Broadcasting System dominates 24/7 our galaxy for over a decade. This stream is non-commercial, non-conventional and nothing like it can be encountered on any planet. You can run all you want, but there is no escaping CBS TV.

prc.label: Panama Racing TV
prc.plot: This stream is Intergalactic FM's video channel called Panama Racing TV and brings the Panama Racing Club to you, or you to the club.

mtv.label: Murder Capital TV
mtv.plot: This stream is Murder Capital's TV channel. Delivering a mix of live recordings from the Panama Racing Club, the best B movies and keeping you updated on UFO sightings. This is the apex of dangerous television.

mw.label: Magic Waves
mw.plot: Hailing from the UK, Magic Waves has been broadcasting since 2006. Known for underground music in their legendary regular Sunday night broadcasts, our team brings you music and culture from the future and past with the highest passion.

laniakea.label: Laniakea
laniakea.tagline: In the sunken city of R'lyeh, something is stirring
laniakea.plot: Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn.

neon.label: Neon
neon.plot: Dreams of Neon transmits from Berlin offering streams from Neon studios and club nights by Lazercat, Naks and the Dreams of Neon residents.

discotto.label: Discotto
discotto.plot: Streaming live and direct from the Woolwich triangle, London. Aural and visual stimulation from the studio featuring Discotto and guests.

elcamino.label: El Camino
elcamino.plot: Miqkael has been a DJ since 1997 and lived in Barcelona from 2000 until 2011, playing at Moog and other clubs. Since that time he has been also performing around Europe. Streaming from his Basque homeland, he shows you the way by mixing love and anger.

shipwrec.label: Shipwrec
shipwrec.plot: Shipwrec Radio is a Nijmegen-based label which focuses on acid, electro, house and techno, with excursions into braindance, ambient and IDM. Featuring DJ Shipwrec, Camiel, Yash and sometimes guest DJs.

muledriver.label: Mule Driver
muledriver.tagline: Mule driving is not a crime
muledriver.plot: Live stream from Mule Driver's machine room

reveal.label: REVEAL
reveal.plot: Sometimes you want to go where everybody knows your name and they're always glad you came. You want to be where you can see our troubles are all the same. You want to be where everybody knows your name.
